translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nzado-lzbqkr Judzs
Mzli kc mz nourla kc topwz, kxnzetu rdr pris x lrtzlvzng nzycmne-lxblrng x drtwrdr esz'ti kx Jiszs nabz.
Nzpetxbzlr mqde x sc tzvzmipelr tzaprcpebzlr mz mq Pcntizs Paelzt, lr Rom kc tqaclvele Judiz Provins.
Judzs kc tqamwabzle Jiszs mz enqmi rdeng, kx mcle kx sa nanibqlr Jiszs, drtwrde vztx zlwz. X twz-mopwzle trau kcng nzpnu-tq (30) tqngi silvz mz kxnzetu rdr pris x lrtzlvzng mz Mangr-nzangiongr.

X rpibzle badr kx, “Alex alwx kxetu zlwz mz nzamwatx-krbo bamu ncblo kc trvz-rbru. X mzli ka sa nabzpe-ngrde da kc tqalex.” Nzayzlu-ngrbzlr natqde kx, “Trpnzngr scgr da kx yctrpz mz da la tqpiq. Krla me pnz drtwrm.”
Zbz Judzs rtctxo-ngrde trau kcng mz Mangr-nzangiongr, x sc tqdwapxpe. Vz x sc tqado-lzbqpe.
Kxnzetu rdr pris nzkalzmlr trau kcng, x nzrpilr kx, “Lou scgu tr-rlrpx-ngrdeu nzyrlqtr-krgu trau lcng mz Mangr-nzangiongr. Murde trau lc ngi dalr nzbzkr ncblo.”
Zbz sc tzaotipe drtwrdr nzxpengr drtc' nyz ncblo kc tqrwzngr pct mz drtc', kx nangi me nzyrtzmqngr lr mrkzbleng.
A' mzbq ka nzrpibz drtc' kx yrleongr mepyr, murde nzxpeng mz trau kx ngi dalr nzbzkr ncblo.
X krlc atutrle natq profet mz Nzryrngrkxtr, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Nztwzlr trau kcng nzpnu-tq (30) kx ngi silvz, murde krlc narncbr kx nzyrlq lr Israel nzxpengr nide.
X nzxpelr drtc' nyz ncblo kc tqrwzngr pct mz drtc'. Da lc vz-nqblqle natq kc tqkam Gct bange.”
Jiszs Nzvzmibz Mz Paelzt
Mzli lc, Jiszs sc tqaycmnetrpe Paelzt, lr Rom kc tqngi gavzna, mz nzvea-krbzle bade kx, “?Myx kxmule, nim king r lr Jiu?” Ayzlu-ngrbz Jiszs natqde kx, “Sa tqplzpxpeq kx ninge.”
A' mzli kc tzrpi-ngrbz kxnzetu rdr pris x lrtzlvzng kx vz-rbr, trayzlupwzleu natqdr.
Zbz Paelzt sc tqveape-mopwz bade kx, “?Trxlrwq da kxkqlu kcng tzrpilr kx oti-rbrbzme?”
A' Jiszs sc tqvz zvz trnzycmne-krdeu. X trpnzngr natq kxesz' kx ayzlu-ngrbzle natqdr. X Paelzt sc tqkctitxpxpele nzanabu-krde.
Paelzt Rlrpx-ngrde Nzbzkr Jiszs
Mz Nzamyangr amrlx, Paelzt aprpxmle kzdq doa lr Jiu kx mnc mz presin kx nzrlxtitrpz lr Jerusalem.
Mzli lc kzdq ncblo kxayo drtqde Barabas mnc mz presin.
Mzli kc tzyrlwrngr leplz kxkqlu, Paelzt rveabz badr kx, “?Neke suti drtwrmu narlr-ngrbo bamu, Barabas o Jiszs kc nzrpibz Kxnzmcpx?”
Krlc tqkxmu nzycmne-krbz Paelzt lc murde krlzle kx Jiszs nzaprcpebz kxnzetu rdr pris bade mz nzdobulvz-krdr nzsuti-zlwzkr drtwr leplz nide.

Mzli kc Paelzt tqwxbuo-ngrbeple mrkc tzrpipxngr nztubqkr doa o trtingr, olvz rde atwzlr-ngrbzle nrpa. Rpibzle kx, “Bzkq da kx nawaisr-ngrn ncblo la. Murde trpnzngr da kx ale-rbrle. X mwiblex nide kau x atalvzo-zlwzmle drtwrnge.”
A' kxnzetu rdr pris nzapqtrpzlr drtwr zbo ngr leplz kcng kx narlxti-alzubzlr mz Paelzt Barabas, x nanibqle Jiszs.
Paelzt rveabz mz zbo ngr leplz kcng kx, “?Neke mz mrlx lcng li kx suti drtwrmu narlr-ngrbo bamu?” Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Barabas!”
Zbz Paelzt vea-mopwz badr kx, “?Nike nawaisr-ngrne Jiszs kc tzrpibz Kxnzmcpx?” A' nzrpibzlr kx, “Natqlvztr mz kros!”
Rpi-mopwz Paelzt kx, “?A' memule? ?Da kxtrka kznike alele?” A' sc tznemi-katobzlr kx, “Natqlvztr mz kros!”

Paelzt krlzpele kx rblxpebz bade nztekqtr-krbzle drtwrdr, x ycpe pipz nzotablrkr leplz kxkqlu mz nzngyatikr drtwrdr nide mz nzycmne-krde. Zbz otile lue, sc tqycpqpele mqde, x rpibzle badr kx, “Krlc rkx kx aelwapx-ngrde kx nzbzkr ncblo lc trtutrpuu bange. A' nzbz-krde tutrpz bamu.”
X leplz lcng nzayzlu-ngrbzlr natqde kx, “Nzbz-krde natutrp bagr x doa negrng.”
Zbz sc tqrlrpe-ngrbzle Barabas badr. X rpibzle mz ncblo ngr vea nedeng kx naiklalr Jiszs x natqlvztrlr nide mz kros.
Kzdung ncblo ngr vea nzvzmitrlr Jiszs mz nabxbz ngr ma kxetu nyz Paelzt, x sc tzkqlepelr ncblo ngr vea kztedrng amrlx.
Nzavotxobzlr nzkq scdeng, x sc tzakqpelr mz nzkq kxpc.

X nzngrlelr kc nqvi nzku ngi kraon scde, nzalaobzlr mz narde. Nzyrlqtrpzlr kc mz mqde dapunc sc kxrmailz. Zbz sc tzrweopebzng zpr bade mz nzapusr-krdr nide king. Sc tzxtrngalvztitrpelr x tzmrgepe-ngrdr nide kx, “Nim la, King r lr Jiu! Nzmnc-krm naboi.”
Nzbyatilr nide x nzkatxpxbzlr dapunc kc x nztakrti-ngrbzlr narde nzwrde kqlu.
Mz nibrde sc tzavopxpebzlr nzkq kc pc x nzavoo-mopwzlr nzkq scde. X sc tzvzmipxpelr mz nzrtqlvztrngr nide mz kros.
Jiszs Nztqlvztr Mz Kros

Kx nzprpxbzlr kc mz nrlarde kx yz ngr mzteadau, sc tzrmctipelr kc ncblo drtqde Saemon. Nide dalr taon kxetu Saerin, mrkc Afrika. X sc tzrtulrtrpe-ngrbz ncblo ngr vea kcng bade nzglq-krbzle kros, murde drtq Jiszs mewetx-zlwzpe.
Ncblo ngr vea kcng nzvzmilr Jiszs mz kzdq newz drtqde Gclgata, drtwr ngrde Bekrlz, murde nzobq-krde apule bekrlz.
Nzkabzlr bade kc waen kx ycmi luekxpiz nzrpibz mrr. Abztrle kxpipz, a' trmnq-pnzleu.
Zbz sc tztqlvztrpelr nide mz kros. X nctq lrpz scdeng nzayrleti ncblo ngr vea kcng daes.
Zbz ncblo ngr vea kcng sc tzwxbupeng x tzaukztipwzlr nide.
Mz nzaelwapxngr da kc tqbzngr Jiszs, nzyrtr kcng natq mz kzdq da x nztqlvztr mrkc tqyc-zbzlz narde. Nzyr kx, Krlc Jiszs, King r Lr Jiu.
X nztqlvztr kz mz kros kzbleng ncblo nzling kxnzpnang da taplxsr nrlar Jiszs.
Mzli kc tqdoo-ngrm Jiszs mz kros, kzdung leplz kx nzvzkimlr mrlcde nzrpitilzbzng natq kxtrkating bade. Nzycngrlrlzbzlr nardr.
X nzrpilzbzlr kx, “Kx tqrpiq kx matq-esz'ngrn mz nzawxo-krm Mangr-nzangiongr x wzti-mowq mz zbq kxtqtxu, e vzom mz kros la mz nzarlapx-lzbq-krm! Krlzq nzale-krmle nzmu nangi-zwpxm mrlx Gct!”
Mz nzmu-krde lcdepwz, kxnzetu rdr pris x kxnzalvztrng mz Lou sc Mosis, x lrtzlvzng nzxtrnga-kz-ngrdr Jiszs mz mzlirdr.
Nzrpilr kx, “Krlzle nzarlapx-krde kzdu-kzng leplz, a' trkrlzleu nzarlapx-lzbq-krde. Nzmu kx tqngini-angidrle King r Israel, navzopem mz kros mzli ka x sc tqlxngitipeku nide.
Drtwrde abrtrpzle mz Gct, x rpile kx nide mrlx Gct. Namcku ena na-arlapxkr Gct nide mzli ka, nzmu mrlzti-zlwzle nide.”
X mz nqmq lcpwz, ncblo kcng nzling tzpnang da tzdo-kzng mz kros, nzrpiti-kzpzng natq kxtrka bade.
Nzbzkr Jiszs
Mzli kc tqtavauo-ngrm nepi, nzlo akqlvztx-pnzle nrlc tulvzo, krlzbzle nabznepi kc tqtq.
X mzli lcpwz, Jiszs sc tqetumipe natqde, nzrpi-krde kx, “Eli! Eli! ?Lama sabaktani?” Drtwr ngrde kx, “Gct! Gct o! ?Memule tqvzszpe-ngrn ninge?”
Kzdung leplz mrkc nzxlr-rbrbzlr natq Jiszs, x sc tzrpipelr kx, “?Xlrbzmu? Kqlepele Profet Elaeja kc bqnc mz nzokatr-krde nide!”
Kzdq nidr otile kc kzdq da, petrle mz nounc, leole mz waen kxrkx, x sc tqglalzpebzle x katrpzle mz nao Jiszs.
A' kzdung kz leplz nzrpibzlr kx, “Na-aenzliku ena, namcku nzvz-krm Elaeja mz nzarlapx-krde nide.”
Zbz Jiszs netxpx-kato mou x sc tqrlrpe-ngrbzle mqngrde mz Gct.
X mzli lcpwz, lotqbr kc tqdo Mrkc Tqtr Mangr-nzangiongr nzpesalikiomle wq tatxo mz noude, ncte li. X mzli lc nengq kxetu vzm x rplz kxetuting nzbxpizting.
X butqbr x gq kcng tzyrbqpx-ngrm namz nzlvxpx-lzbqng x nrkrdrtq leplz neng Gct kxkqlu nztulz-mopqng mz nzbzngr.
Nzrlaszlr butqbr kcng x mz nibr nztulz-mou-krm Jiszs mz nzbzngr, sc tzvztrpeng mzteadau kxtr Jerusalem, x nzmc leplz kxnzkqlung nidr elr.

Kzdq kxetu kx aclvele dzbe ncblo ngr vea ngr Rom kc trtqki-esz' (100) tulzbz mz nou kros badr kzdung kz ncblo ngr vea mz nzaukzlz-krbzlr mz Jiszs. Kxnzmclr nengq x da lcng tqprtzting, nzmwxlr-zlwz-ngrdr. X sc tzrpipelr kx, “Da zpwxtx, ncblo ka nide Mrlx Gct.”
Kzdung olvz nzmnc-kzng mrlcde, sc tztumqng rlru, x nzmclr da kcng tzwaisrngr Jiszs. Olvz lcng nzvzkimlr Gzlili x nzvzdzng badr Jiszs Jerusalem mz nzokatr-krdr nide.
Kzdung olvz lcdeng nidr seleng, Mxri kc Makdala, Mxri lxe Jemes x Josip, x lxe Jemes x Jon.
Jiszs Nzyrtzmq
Mzli kc tqycpe pipz nztaokr nepi x Sabat kc tqyzutrpe, kzdq bcnyr vzm. Nide ncblo ngr taon Arimatia, drtqde Josip x lxngitile Jiszs.
Vzbz mz Paelzt x sc tqrlxtipebzle nrkrdrtq Jiszs, kx nayrtzmqle. X sc tqpipebz Paelzt mz ncblo nedeng kx narlr-ngrbzlr bade.
Zbz Josip glqle nrkrdrtq Jiszs x sc tqbxtipele lrpz kxprki.
X sc tqyrlqtrpele namz ngr Jiszs mz gq lr kxnzbz nyzde, kc tqekqtitr-atele mz butqbr. Alqlitrpzle kc rplz kxetu kx na-apqbrtr-ngrbzle naonrx ngrde, x sc tqvzpe.
Mxri kc Makdala x kzdq kz Mxri nzwxbutrpzng yz mz butqbr kc, x nzmclr da amrlx kcng tqaleting Josip.
Ncblo Kcng Tzaukzng Mz Gq Lr Jiszs
Zbq kc navz-mop ngi Sabat. X kxnzetu rdr pris x Farzsi nzvzbzng mz Paelzt.
Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Kxetu, dcpx mz drtwrgr mzli kc tqlubengr blzpokia kc, rpile kx, ‘Zbq naotx natq, x ninge kc tqlupe-mopwc'.’

Mz nzmu-krde lcde, kapx natqm kx navz du ncblo ngr vea nemqng mz nzaukz-krdr mrkc tzyrtzmqngr nide, nakrlz-zpwxbzle nzyrkrpxkr zbq kcng tq. Murde ncblo nedeng ma tzvzmqng, tzpnatipelr namz ngrde, x sc tzpipebzlr mz leplz kx lupe mou. Nzpokiangr lc sa naetutx zlwz namyaszpxle nzpokiangr kx nide Kxnzmcpx.”
Rpibz Paelzt badr kx, “Vzmiamu du ncblo ngr vea nengeng x namctr mz nzaukz-krdr kx trpnzngr kx vznebz mrlcde.”

Zbz sc tzvzpeng x tzamqngitrpelr butqbr mz nzamnc-krdr ncblo ngr vea kcng mz nzaukz-krdr elr, x mz nzayrlenitrngr kadol mrkc tqmwitrngr rplz kc mz butqbr kc. Murde nakrlz-ngrdr kx rlvxtrpe kc naonrx mz nzmrglckr dalr kadol kc.

footnotes.text: Kxmule-esz' drtwr Judzs vztx, a' trtekqtrleu nqmq nr drtwrde mz nzrlxti-krbzle mz Gct nzipq-krde nide.
Mz drtwr lr Jiu, natq lc tqngi “King r lr Jiu” nangi drtq kx pipxle kx nide Kxnzmcpx. Suti drtwrdr kx Paelzt nalxngitile kx Jiszs avzole zmatq ngr king kxetu mrkc Rom, mz nzngini-krde kz king.

27:33 Mz natq lr Rom, Bekrlz nzrpibz Kalvzri. 27:34 Mrr, kala ngrde bla. Nzwzngr mz lue lr be nounc kxlala nzrpibz mrr. Nzaleti mz da kxkqlu, x ngi kz tolo x medesin. Mrlc nzyrlqmi waen, ngi dalr nzaesakingr zvetq. Jiszs trmnq-pnzleu murde mz nzvz-nqblq-krde me pnz drtwr Gct Trte, natwzle zvetq atwrnrngr x naxngitrle nzxpepx-krde alwx ngr leplz amrlx.

Jiszs krlzle nzarlapx-lzbq-krde. A' murde rpile na-arlapxle leplz mz alwx ngrdrng, tekqtrle nidr mz nzayrplapxkr Gct nide. Dekc trarlapx-lzbq-ngru Jiszs. Naglqlz-ngrgu Gct nzrlrpx-lzbq-krde mz nzbz-krde nigu.

27:45 Nzetqkr drtq kc tqprtilzle Jiszs mz Matiu 27 nzplzpx kai mz Sam 22 x Sam 69. Alwx ngrgung dekcng tqbatrpzle nzvzszkr Gct Jiszs. 27:46 Natq lr Jiu mzli kc pnz ngi Hibru. X Eli apu-kzpwzle nzrpingr drtq Elaeja. Mc kz 2 King 2:11.
